newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.03 pct in seesaw trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.03 pct in seesaw trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.03 percent in seesaw trade to close at 1.0723 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The real was traded between 1.0718 and 1.0730 per dollar throughout the day, with players following the direction of dollar flows as they did on Thursday, dealers added.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts at 1635 local/1935 GMT showed a $40 million deficit.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.06 percent to end at 1.0766 per greenback.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to close at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
